blurb: Urbanna Town Marina provides over 15 transient boat slips including a 27-foot wide mega-slip and a long dock for boats over 90 feet. Amenities include 30 and 50 amp electrical service, WiFi, water, laundry, bath house, pump out, bicycles, and handicapped accessibility. The marina is located two-tenths of a mile from downtown Urbanna with nearby shops, restaurants, and services.
extraNote: The bridge leading to the marina is currently CLOSED to vehicular traffic; marina accessible to pedestrians and incoming boat traffic · mid-April through mid-November
